description: Stay powered on the go with this sleek and compact 20,000 mAh power bank designed for convenience and reliable performance. The power bank comes with multiple charging options, including a Type-C port, USB-A port, and an in-built Type-C cable, making it easy to charge different devices without carrying extra cables. Its compact and lightweight design makes it easy to carry in your pocket or bag, perfect for travel and daily use. Built with SafeCharge technology, it includes protection circuits to help keep your devices safe while charging. It is compatible with Type-C and USB-A devices such as smartphones and other gadgets. *These Ambrane Power Bank images are for illustration purpose only.
